[GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go] Issue #370: [Place List] Create DB View views_place_list
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Create the views_place_list database view that aggregates posts by location_name. This is Step 1 of the Place List feature implementation.

Reference: PLACE_LIST_BRAINSTORM.md → STEP 1

Why a View?

All existing complex list endpoints query a view (e.g. views_hashtag, views_timeline_post_slim, views_nearest_posts). Using a view keeps the handler lean and the SQL independently testable.

SQL to Execute

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_list AS
SELECT
    p.location_name,

    -- location_post from the most recent post at this place
    (
        SELECT p2.location_post
        FROM public.posts p2
        WHERE p2.location_name = p.location_name
          AND p2.is_publish    = true
          AND p2.visibility    = 'public'
          AND p2.banned        = false
        ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS location_post,

    -- thumbnail from the most recent post at this place
    (
        SELECT p2.thumbnail
        FROM public.posts p2
        WHERE p2.location_name = p.location_name
          AND p2.is_publish    = true
          AND p2.visibility    = 'public'
          AND p2.banned        = false
        ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS thumbnail,

    COUNT(p.id)                       AS total_posts,
    COALESCE(SUM(v.view_count), 0)    AS total_views,

    json_agg(
        DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
            'avatar',   u.avatar,
            'username', u.username,
            'encrypt',  u.encrypt
        )
    ) FILTER (WHERE u.id IS NOT NULL) AS contributors,

    u.encrypt AS encrypt

FROM public.posts p
JOIN public.users u ON u.id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count
    FROM public.views
    GROUP BY post_id
) v ON v.post_id = p.id
WHERE p.is_publish    = true
  AND p.visibility    = 'public'
  AND p.banned        = false
  AND p.location_name IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location_name != ''
  AND u.banned        = false
  AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM public.users_request_delete)
GROUP BY p.location_name;

Validation Query

SELECT location_name, total_posts, total_views, thumbnail
FROM views_place_list
ORDER BY total_posts DESC
LIMIT 5;

Expected: rows with location_name, non-zero total_posts, total_views, and a thumbnail URL.

Acceptance Criteria

  • View views_place_list exists in the database
  • View returns correct total_posts count per location_name
  • View returns correct total_views count per location_name
  • thumbnail reflects the most recent post's thumbnail for each place
  • contributors is a JSON array of distinct user objects { avatar, username, encrypt }
  • Deactivated, banned, and soft-deleted users are excluded from results
  • Only is_publish=true, visibility=public, banned=false posts included

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go] Issue #382: [Place Detail] Plugin 2 — DB View: views_place_detail_posts
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Phase 1 · No dependencies · Reference: PLACE_DETAIL_BRAINSTORM.md Plugin 2

Creates views_place_detail_posts — the data source for the Posts tab on Place Detail. Exposes a top-level encrypt column (absent from views_timeline_post_slim) so deactivated/blocked users can be filtered in Go.

SQL to Run

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_detail_posts AS
SELECT
    p.location_name,
    p.slug,
    p.thumbnail,
    p.description,
    p.created_at,
    p.post_type,
    p.animation,
    p.little_planet,
    p.score_timeline,
    u.encrypt,
    json_build_object(
        'avatar',    u.avatar,
        'fullname',  u.fullname,
        'username',  u.username,
        'encrypt',   u.encrypt
    ) AS data_user,
    json_build_object('aggregate', json_build_object('count', COALESCE(v.views_count, 0))) AS views_aggregate,
    json_build_object('aggregate', json_build_object('count', COALESCE(l.likes_count, 0))) AS likes_aggregate,
    json_build_object('aggregate', json_build_object('count', COALESCE(c.comments_count, 0))) AS comments_aggregate,
    CASE WHEN b.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS potd
FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p
JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS u ON u.id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (post_id) post_id FROM panorra_dev.public.broadcast ORDER BY post_id, created_at DESC) AS b ON b.post_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS views_count FROM panorra_dev.public.views GROUP BY post_id) AS v ON v.post_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS likes_count FROM panorra_dev.public."like" GROUP BY post_id) AS l ON l.post_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS comments_count FROM panorra_dev.public.comment WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND banned = false GROUP BY post_id) AS c ON c.post_id = p.id
WHERE
    p.is_publish = true AND p.visibility = 'public' AND p.banned = false AND u.banned = false
    AND p.location_name IS NOT NULL AND p.location_name != ''
    AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM panorra_dev.public.users_request_delete)
GROUP BY
    p.location_name, p.slug, p.thumbnail, p.description, p.created_at, p.post_type,
    p.animation, p.little_planet, p.score_timeline, u.encrypt, u.avatar, u.fullname, u.username,
    b.post_id, v.views_count, l.likes_count, c.comments_count;

Verification

SELECT location_name, slug, potd FROM views_place_detail_posts WHERE location_name = 'CN Tower' LIMIT 3;

Used by

Plugin 7 — Handler GetPlaceDetailPosts

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go] Issue #383: [Place Detail] Plugin 3 — DB View: views_place_detail_contributors
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Phase 1 · No dependencies · Reference: PLACE_DETAIL_BRAINSTORM.md Plugin 3

Creates views_place_detail_contributors — per-user aggregates at a place for the Contributors tab. Uses RANK() window function to compute contributor_rank so the handler can set the Top Contributor badge without extra computation.

SQL to Run

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_detail_contributors AS
SELECT
    location_name, user_id, encrypt, avatar, fullname, username, total_posts, total_views,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location_name ORDER BY total_views DESC, total_posts DESC) AS contributor_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.location_name,
        u.id           AS user_id,
        u.encrypt, u.avatar, u.fullname, u.username,
        COUNT(p.id)                    AS total_posts,
        COALESCE(SUM(v.view_count), 0) AS total_views
    FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p
    JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS u ON u.id = p.user_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM panorra_dev.public.views GROUP BY post_id) AS v ON v.post_id = p.id
    WHERE
        p.is_publish = true AND p.visibility = 'public' AND p.banned = false AND u.banned = false
        AND p.location_name IS NOT NULL AND p.location_name != ''
        AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM panorra_dev.public.users_request_delete)
    GROUP BY p.location_name, u.id, u.encrypt, u.avatar, u.fullname, u.username
) AS agg;

Verification

SELECT contributor_rank, fullname, total_posts, total_views
FROM views_place_detail_contributors
WHERE location_name = 'CN Tower'
ORDER BY contributor_rank ASC LIMIT 5;
-- Row with contributor_rank = 1 is the Top Contributor

Used by

Plugin 8 — Handler GetPlaceDetailContributors

Key logic

  • Rank 1 = highest total_views at that location → handler sets top_contributor: true
  • Following status NOT in view — resolved in Go layer via batch followers query

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go] Issue #384: [Place Detail] Plugin 4 — DB View: views_place_detail_bookmarks
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Phase 2 · Depends on Plugin 1 (migration must run first) · Reference: PLACE_DETAIL_BRAINSTORM.md Plugin 4

Creates views_place_detail_bookmarks — published bookmark folders containing posts at a given location, for the Bookmarks tab. This is a net-new concept: published bookmark folders are public curations discoverable via place detail.

Prerequisite

folder_bookmark.is_published column must exist (Plugin 1 / issue #381).

SQL to Run

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_detail_bookmarks AS
SELECT
    p.location_name,
    fb.id AS folder_id, fb.name AS folder_name, fb.slug AS folder_slug,
    u.id AS owner_id, u.avatar AS owner_avatar, u.username AS owner_username, u.encrypt AS owner_encrypt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bm.id)          AS total_posts,
    COALESCE(SUM(v.view_count), 0) AS total_views,
    (
        SELECT p2.thumbnail
        FROM panorra_dev.public.bookmark AS bm2
        JOIN panorra_dev.public.posts AS p2 ON p2.id = bm2.post_id
        WHERE bm2.folder_id = fb.id AND p2.location_name = p.location_name
          AND p2.is_publish = true AND p2.visibility = 'public' AND p2.banned = false
        ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) AS folder_thumbnail,
    BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN b.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) AS potd
FROM panorra_dev.public.folder_bookmark AS fb
JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS u ON u.id = fb.user_id
JOIN panorra_dev.public.bookmark AS bm ON bm.folder_id = fb.id
JOIN panorra_dev.public.posts AS p ON p.id = bm.post_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM panorra_dev.public.views GROUP BY post_id) AS v ON v.post_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (post_id) post_id FROM panorra_dev.public.broadcast ORDER BY post_id, created_at DESC) AS b ON b.post_id = p.id
WHERE
    fb.is_published = true
    AND p.is_publish = true AND p.visibility = 'public' AND p.banned = false AND u.banned = false
    AND p.location_name IS NOT NULL AND p.location_name != ''
    AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM panorra_dev.public.users_request_delete)
GROUP BY fb.id, fb.name, fb.slug, u.id, u.avatar, u.username, u.encrypt, p.location_name;

Verification

-- Returns 0 rows until a folder is published (expected behaviour)
SELECT folder_name, owner_username, total_posts, potd FROM views_place_detail_bookmarks LIMIT 3;

-- After manually setting a test folder: UPDATE folder_bookmark SET is_published = true WHERE id = '...'
SELECT folder_name, owner_username, total_posts FROM views_place_detail_bookmarks WHERE location_name = 'CN Tower';

Used by

Plugin 9 — Handler GetPlaceDetailBookmarks

Creates src/Action/V1/Places/PlaceDetailHeaderHandler.go — a new file. Handles the standalone header endpoint that the frontend loads once on screen entry before tab switching.

Route: GET /places/detail?location_name=CN+Tower

Query strategy

Aggregates views_place_list for a single location_name:

SELECT location_name, thumbnail, location_post,
       SUM(total_posts) AS total_posts, SUM(total_views) AS total_views
FROM views_place_list
WHERE location_name = ?
  AND encrypt NOT IN (deactivated/blocked)
GROUP BY location_name, thumbnail, location_post
LIMIT 1

(thumbnail and location_post are identical across all user rows for the same location_name — both come from the same correlated subquery in the view.)

Auth / filter pattern

Exact copy of GetPlaceList pattern:

  • Role validation (user / viewer)
  • Redis deactivated users key: PREFIX_deactive_users_ec
  • Redis blocked users key: PREFIX_blocked_users_ec_{encrypt}
  • ec: true header → encrypted cry response

Response key

data.data → PlaceDetailHeader struct (from Plugin 5)

Creates src/Action/V1/Places/PlaceDetailContributorsHandler.go — a new file. Handles the Contributors tab on Place Detail screen. Includes a 3-query pattern to resolve following status.

Route: GET /places/detail/contributors?location_name=CN+Tower&page=1&limit=20

Query strategy (3 queries total)

-- 1. COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM views_place_detail_contributors
WHERE location_name = ? AND encrypt NOT IN (...)

-- 2. FETCH contributors (paginated)
SELECT user_id, encrypt, avatar, fullname, username, total_posts, total_views, contributor_rank
FROM views_place_detail_contributors
WHERE location_name = ? AND encrypt NOT IN (...)
ORDER BY contributor_rank ASC
LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

-- 3. Resolve following (user role only — one batch query)
SELECT user_id FROM followers
WHERE follower_id = '{currentUserUUID}' AND user_id IN ({contributorUserIDs})

Following status logic

  1. Get current user UUID: SELECT id FROM users WHERE encrypt = ?
  2. Collect user_id from fetched contributors
  3. Single IN query on followers table → build followingSet map[string]bool
  4. Shape response: IsFollowing = followingSet[rc.UserID]

For role = viewer: skip steps 1-3, IsFollowing always false

Top Contributor badge

TopContributor = rc.ContributorRank == 1 (global rank, computed in view)

go build ./...

# Vet all touched packages
go vet ./src/Models/... ./src/Action/V1/Places/... ./src/Controllers/V1/... ./src/Routes/V1/...

# Confirm new routes registered (expect 4 lines with 'detail')
grep "detail" src/Routes/V1/PlacesRoutes.go

# Confirm new structs exist (expect 5 matches)
grep "PlaceDetailHeader\|PlaceDetailPost\|PlaceDetailContributorRaw\|PlaceDetailContributorResponse\|PlaceDetailBookmarkFolder" src/Models/PlacesModel.go

API Checklist

GET /places/detail

  • Missing location_name → 400
  • Valid location → 200 with correct total_posts, total_views, thumbnail
  • Deactivated user's posts excluded from header totals
  • ec: true → encrypted cry response

GET /places/detail/posts

  • Posts sorted by created_at DESC
  • Pagination (page=2&limit=5) returns correct offset slice
  • potd: true on posts that are in broadcast table
  • Deactivated/blocked user posts excluded
  • ec: true response works

GET /places/detail/contributors

  • Sorted by contributor_rank ASC (rank 1 first)
  • top_contributor: true on rank-1 row only
  • is_following: true when current user follows a contributor
  • is_following: false for role=viewer
  • Deactivated contributors excluded
  • Pagination works

GET /places/detail/bookmarks

  • Returns 0 items when no folder is published at that location
  • Returns items after setting folder_bookmark.is_published = true
  • Sorted by total_views DESC
  • thumbnail = most recent post thumbnail in folder at location
  • potd: true when any bookmarked post in folder at location is in broadcast
  • Deactivated folder owners excluded
  • Pagination works

Edge cases (all endpoints)

  • location_name with spaces (e.g. CN+Tower) → correctly decoded
  • location_name with apostrophe (e.g. O%27Brien%27s+Pub) → correctly decoded
  • location_name with slash (e.g. NY%2FNJ+Border) → correctly decoded
  • Unknown location → 200 with empty arrays and total: 0
  • viewer role → e4 field in ec response
